messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Issue with displaying association rules
parts:
Hi Bob,

I have seen this problem before.

If you go to the log tab and copy the command to the Console it works:

> inspect(sort(crs$apriori, by="confidence"))

Regards,
Graham
